row:
I'm Emi I share my life with my rodents and other pets, and you can find fun weekly videos about them here on my channel as well as educational videos about their care! I have a BSc Zoology degree and I'm on a personal mission to make sure rodents get the proper recognition and care that they deserve 💓
I also run a small animal rescue called Critter Haven, and you'll occasionally see videos of that too!
